landing.title: Add IHSP to your home screen
landing.subtitle: Install the app and open it in one tap, like any other app on your phone.

benefits.fast: Opens full screen in one tap
benefits.offline: Timetable, homework and grades work without internet
benefits.session: You stay signed in for up to 90 days
benefits.push: Install to get notifications about new marks

installed.title: IHSP is installed
installed.text: Open it from your home screen.

ios.title: Install on iPhone or iPad
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in the browser bar
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
ios.step3: Tap Add. IHSP appears on your home screen.
ios.openInSafari: This browser cannot add apps to the home screen. Open this page in Safari and try again.
ios.pushNote: On iPhone, notifications only work once the app is installed.

manual.title: Install from the browser menu
manual.step1: Open the browser menu (the three dots)
manual.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen
manual.step3: Confirm. IHSP appears on your home screen.

desktop.title: Open IHSP on your phone
desktop.scan: Point your phone camera at the code, then add the app to your home screen.
desktop.qrLabel: QR code with the address of the IHSP app

telegram.hint: Prefer Telegram? The IHSP mini app works there with nothing to install.

lock.title: IHSP is locked
lock.wrong: Wrong PIN. {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Signing you out…
lock.signOutFailed: Could not sign you out. Check your connection: the app stays locked and tries again when you are online.
lock.forgotText: You will be signed out on this device and the PIN will be removed. You can sign in again with your password.

settings.title: App lock
settings.description: Ask for a PIN when the app is opened, and again after it was in the background for the time you choose.

errors.length: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
errors.storage: The PIN could not be saved on this device.

relock.title: Ask for the PIN again
relock.hint: How long the app may stay in the background before it asks for the PIN. It always asks when the app starts.

hub.title: More IHSP apps
hub.subtitle: Each app installs on its own: open it and add it to your home screen.
